UNH.rationale: UNH is a best-in-class managed-care franchise with durable structural advantages (vertical integration of payer/provider/PBM/analytics, dominant MA position, recurring inelastic revenue). Q1 2026 delivered a decisive operational beat: adjusted EPS of $7.23 vs $6.58 consensus (~10% beat), revenue of $111.7B up 2% YoY, MLR improved 90bp to 83.9%, and FY2026 guidance raised to >$18.25 from >$17.75. Management accelerated $2B buybacks and is de-leveraging (debt-to-capital 42.9%, targeting 40% year-end). The CMS 2.48% MA rate increase for 2027 is a material tailwind vs the initially proposed 0.09%. However, the stock has already re-rated ~30% in one month to ~19x forward earnings, Optum revenues are flat with Optum Health down 3%, MA membership shed 965K seniors, medical cost inflation remains elevated with Q1 benefiting from seasonal factors, and a DOJ probe into Optum Rx is unresolved. The franchise quality is high and the turnaround is showing early results, but the sharp re-rating and unresolved headwinds (elevated utilization, Optum trough, regulatory risk) mean the easy value has been captured. Score reflects strong fundamentals and positive trajectory offset by valuation that is no longer clearly cheap after the rally, with a modest positive bump from the CMS rate catalyst.
